posts.title: Booknotes #2
posts.description: Stuff I've been reading, with a US-history slant: Robert Caro - The Years of Lyndon Johnson I, and three books from a volume of Joan Didion's collected works.

posts.title: An Alkalic Enigma
posts.description: Here's an atomic-physics puzzle: you're given two unmarked vapor cells which are filled with potassium (K) and rubidium (Rb), respectively. How do you tell which is which, without resorting to spectroscopy?

posts.title: Letters from the Frontier
posts.description: A cowboy rode west on his horse, said: "I'll write to you weekly of course. Though, my mail you'll receive, with some extra reprieve, cause I'm a Dopplerian source!"
